instruction: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and keep it open. Complete the accessible transport request template on the Desktop using the supplied request details, then save the completed form as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and leave it open.

Replace the template placeholders so the document reads `ACCESSIBLE TRANSPORT REQUEST
Name: Morgan Lee
Member ID: AT-20491
Pickup date: 24 September 2026
Mobility aid: folding wheelchair`.
Save the completed document as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
Leave the Windows On-Screen Keyboard open.

result.command: powershell -Command "if (Get-Process osk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'OSK_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'OSK_CLOSED' }"

result.textcontent:
ACCESSIBLE TRANSPORT REQUEST
Name: Morgan Lee
Member ID: AT-20491
Pickup date: 24 September 2026
Mobility aid: folding wheelchair
